The user wants me to convert an image of a "Semiconductor / AI Value Chain Panorama" chart into HTML.

**1. Analyze the Document Structure:**

- **Main Table:** A large table with 4 columns: "层级" (Level), "主要作用" (Main Function), "代表企业 (示例)" (Representative Companies), "在AI生态中的角色" (Role in AI Ecosystem).
- **Rows:** There are 10 numbered rows (1-10), each representing a layer of the value chain.
    - Row 1: Architecture Design / IP Layer
    - Row 2: Chip Design (Fabless)
    - Row 3: Wafer Manufacturing (Foundry)
    - Row 4: Equipment (Production Equipment)
    - Row 5: Packaging & Testing (OSAT)
    - Row 6: Memory
    - Row 7: Power Chips & Power Management
    - Row 8: Connectivity & Networking
    - Row 9: Systems & Infrastructure
    - Row 10: Cloud Computing / Hyperscale (End Users)
- **Footer:** A "Key Points" section with a target icon and text, followed by a flow diagram showing the sequence (IP -> Chip Design -> Wafer Mfg -> Packaging -> Memory -> Power Mgmt -> Connectivity -> System Integration -> Cloud Deployment).
- **Disclaimer:** Small text at the very bottom.

**2. Visual Styling & Layout:**
- **Colors:** Dark blue header, alternating row colors (white, light blue, light green, light yellow, light purple, light orange, light blue, light blue, light purple).
- **Icons:** Each row has a specific icon in the first column.
- **Logos:** The third column contains logos of companies. I need to represent these as text or placeholders since I can't generate actual images, but the prompt asks for "faithful reproduction". I will use text representations of the logos where possible or simple placeholders if they are purely graphical, but looking closely, they are mostly text-based logos (e.g., "arm", "NVIDIA", "tsmc"). I will transcribe the text.
